description: Historical available-PV-power simulation for the 13 Spanish 'Weather House' CSVs. Panel counts and inverter selections are authorized illustrative scenarios, not the real installations.

expected_source._note: Values from the earlier audit of the original files; the script verifies them and reports any mismatch.

source_units.Sun Azimuth (rad): rad, assumed north = 0, clockwise positive (pvlib convention)
source_units._status: assumed units; not confirmed by the data provider

setting_provenance.panel_stc_power_w: user-supplied table (Houses 4 and 8: 445 W explicitly selected by the user over the 440 W model name)
setting_provenance.azimuth_deg: scenario assumption: 180 deg (south) for every house
setting_provenance.gamma_pdc_per_c: Trina (Houses 1, 9, 12): DE18M(II) family datasheet, installed revision unconfirmed; all others: assumed -0.0035 /degC
setting_provenance.panel_count: authorized illustrative scenario (the paper does not report real installations)
setting_provenance.inverter_type: authorized illustrative scenario; internal only, not exported
setting_provenance.inverter_unit_count: authorized illustrative scenario (microinverters: one unit per panel)
setting_provenance.inverter_nominal_efficiency: generic assumption, not a validated manufacturer curve
setting_provenance.dc_loss_fraction: scenario assumption: flat 10 % aggregate DC loss
setting_provenance.temperature_model_parameters: generic thermal approximation for all houses; not a claim about module construction

notes: gamma -0.0034 /degC from the Trina DE18M(II) family sheet; exact installed revision unconfirmed

bifacial module simulated front side only: rear gain 0 because bifaciality, ground clearance, row spacing and rear obstruction are unavailable; front-side ground reflection uses the supplied Surface Albedo
microinverters receive equal per-panel DC power; no shading or MPPT advantage is modelled
